messages.subject: MENA Executive Profile | Industrial, ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Sami,

I am reaching out because your leadership of Wilton & Bain across the Middle East and North Africa, together with your executive search work across industrial and transformation-led organisations, aligns closely with the GCC transition I am pursuing.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory within a major gold-mining operation.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director or Representative, Executive Director and VP-track mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC. My strongest fit is at the intersection of country leadership, external affairs, government relations, ESG, strategic partnerships, natural resources, energy transition, infrastructure and industrial operations.

I am internationally mobile, open to expatriate and residential assignments, and available on 30 days' notice. My GCC-focused executive CV is attached for consideration across suitable current or confidential mandates.

Preferred reply address: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
